name: jr-rails-skills
description: Rails coding skills: classic style, Phlex components, app scaffolder, Mac bootstrap

plugins.name: jr-rails-new
plugins.description: Scaffold a new Rails app with preferred stack

plugins.name: jr-rails-phlex
plugins.description: Write Phlex views and components for Rails

plugins.name: jr-rails-second-opinion
plugins.description: Get a Rails-flavored second opinion on a branch, PR, or working tree by delegating to a locally-installed agentic CLI (codex, opencode, gemini, aider, etc.)

plugins.name: jr-rails-pr-tour
plugins.description: Turn a large Rails PR or MR into a guided reading order: chapters of related files ordered by layer and dependency, with churn-x-complexity risk badges, published as an artifact that drives the diff in a second tab. GitHub and GitLab

plugins.name: jr-rails-bootstrap
plugins.description: One-time Mac bootstrap from blank dev environment to a running Rails app. Installs Xcode CLT, Homebrew, mise, Ruby, Node, gh/glab, the jr-rails skills pack, then delegates to jr-rails-new
